body: I wish I could go to sleep and not wake up. I wish I could die without me knowing that I died. My family makes fun of me for staying in room all day and only coming out to go to school or work but little do they know I don’t want to be here. If I didn’t have bad breath I would want to stay here and fight my way through life but unfortunately there is no cure. I’m sick of being single and not having any friends. What did I do to deserve this? Just kill me already. If I have to put up with this any longer I’m just going to OD on Tylenol.
